display_long_description:
Unleash raw telekinetic power.

In Kinetic Surge VR you don't touch what you fight — you command it. Reach out, grip a floating object from across the dark arena, pull it to your hand, then flick to HURL it at the waves of hostile drones closing in. Two-handed: each hand seizes, holds, and throws on its own, so you can have two objects screaming through the void at once.

Survive the onslaught. Drones advance from the dark; smash them mid-air before they breach your energy core. Chain your kills for a x2 / x4 / x8 multiplier, ride the combo, and climb the leaderboard. Push your luck across Easy, Normal, and Hard as the swarm grows faster and thicker every wave.

FEATURES
• Telekinetic grab-and-throw combat — point, grip, pull, hurl
• Dual-wield force — two hands, two objects in flight
• Endless escalating drone waves with a combo multiplier
• Three difficulty tiers + best-score progression and coins
• A glowing, dark sci-fi arena built for standing-room VR

No motion sickness: you stand your ground and let the arena come to you.
